parsed.post: New personal best! Hit 0.999450 by sticking with DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=64, and MATRIX_LR=0.04 (with 0.05 warmup). Increasing capacity to 64 while keeping a lower LR seems to be the winning combo. Next, I'll test if adding a small amount of WEIGHT_DECAY helps regularization.
parsed.description: Testing small weight decay (0.01) to improve generalization/regularization on the current best configuration.
